what: The double border of the text panel is drawn with diagonal cuts — the outer 2px line unfolds from the top-left·bottom-right corners, the inner 1px line (30px smaller than the outer) from the top-right·bottom-left corners, triangles spreading to the diagonal and revealing two sides each (2s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)). Once, when the panel reaches 75% of the screen. The frame border of the invitation·greeting panels

options.on: When to draw — default scroll (when it enters the screen), state (when the element gets is-active — to start together with other entrances), load (right on attach)
options.state: on: class to wait for when state, default is-active
options.look: single: Just one thin inner layer, same size as the panel (photo slot frame — from the top-right and bottom-left corners)
options.ease: Curve (css name or four numbers like “.23,1,.32,1”), default cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)
options.inset: How much narrower the inner layer is than the outer (px, both sides combined), default 30 — phone original also 30, wide screens 25
options.--fx-line · --fx-w-out · --fx-w-in · --f: (css variable) line color (default --kf-line) · outer weight 2px · inner weight 1px · layer z-index 2

from.options: Greeting section inset 21(1440)·30(phone) · photo frame look: single
